description:
📊 Wie profitabel ist ein Event wirklich, und wohin entwickeln sich unsere Zahlen in den nächsten Monaten? Bei Dreamlight Labs findest du es heraus. Wir suchen eine zahlenstarke Persönlichkeit, die unsere Finanzen und das Controlling übernimmt und zur Expert:in für alles wird, was bei uns mit Geld zu tun hat.
Du willst in einem wachsenden Start-up Verantwortung für die Zahlen übernehmen und neue Strukturen aufbauen? Wir freuen uns auf dich! 🎉
Deine Aufgaben als Finance & Controlling Manager:in
Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich unser Controlling und unsere Finanzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit der Geschäftsführung aus und bringst Struktur in einen businesskritischen Bereich.
Monatliches Controlling und Forecast: Zahlen auswerten, Abweichungen erkennen und Forecasts laufend aktualisieren

Kostenüberblick: u.a. Event-, Personal- und Marketingkosten steuern, inklusive Marketingabgrenzung und Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung

Eventkalkulation: verstehen und weiterentwickeln

Finanzbuchhaltung: Basics sicher abdecken, dazu Intercompany und Quellensteuern

Struktur schaffen: Tabellen und internes Finanz-Tool verstehen, eigene Prozesse aufbauen

Reporting: Zahlen für die Geschäftsführung aufbereiten und Handlungsbedarf erkennen

Das bringst du mit
2–3 Jahre Vollzeiterfahrung in Finance, Controlling, Buchhaltung oder Steuerberatung

Sicherer Umgang mit Kennzahlen, Forecasts sowie Kenntnisse in der Finanzbuchhaltung

title: Growth Lead (m/f/d)
summary: About viral.app viral.app is the software brands and agencies use to run UGC marketing at scale. It helps to hire creators, track every video on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Snapchat, and…
description:
About viral.app
viral.app is the software brands and agencies use to run UGC marketing at scale. It helps to hire creators, track every video on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Snapchat, and pay creators based on performance.
So far the founders have run marketing alongside everything else: SEO and content, free tools, our newsletter The FYP Leak, Google Ads, and posts on LinkedIn and X. Tracking and a lot of the scrappy growth work already run on AI automations we built ourselves. We're hiring a Growth Lead for the channels and content that don't automate well and need skill and taste.
This is a hands-on role. You set the plan and do most of the work together with the founders.
Your tasks
Own growth end to end: the plan, the budget and the execution.

Build a niche audience around creator marketing on LinkedIn and X under your own name. If you already have one, bring it. If you don't, you're motivated to build it from zero.

Create the content formats that are hard to automate, for example short-form video, customer stories, founder-led posts and deep dives on what makes UGC perform.

Test and run any channel that could bring us customers, for example LinkedIn, X, YouTube, cold email, Google Ads, Meta ads, organic content, AEO (getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews), Reddit, affiliate marketing and B2B creators. Spend most of your time on the channels where quality beats volume.

For paid channels, run the ad accounts yourself: targeting,…

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.

Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.

These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.

We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

About us
We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects
About our technology
The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

Project Bay ist der erste CoWorking-Living Space mit direktem Meerzugang und neuer Hotspot für Innovation im Norden. Die Themen „Digitalisierung, Künstliche Intelligenz und neue Mobilitätslösungen“ werden hierbei mit regionaler Community, Work-Life-Balance und Natur pur verbunden.

Wir bieten unseren Kunden Büro- und CoWorking-Flächen, Break-Out-Optionen sowie Fortbildungen, Freizeitangebote und Übernachtungen direkt am Meer auf Rügen. Des Weiteren verfügen wir über einen Accelerator "Founders Bay", um junge Startups mit Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit zu unterstützen.

Ab sofort sind wir auch im Aufbau des ersten MakerSpaces auf der Insel Rügen. Neben digitalen Lösungen ist es notwendig auch einen Ort für Hardware-Lösungen zu schaffen.

Mit den Synergien unseres neuen Accelerators für nachhaltige Startups und den Kooperationen zu den Hochschulen, Kammern usw., möchten wir mit dem MakerSpace einen Ort für Handwerk, Selbstständige, Kreative und Startups schaffen.

Neben diesen Themen beschäftigen wir uns rundum neue Projekte im Bereich: Expansion mit neuen Spaces, IT Lösungen, CarSharing, Tinyhäuser und noch vieles mehr.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Nebius is looking for a Senior / Lead Program Manager to help develop and execute our asset-light model for expanding AI infrastructure through partnerships.

You will work at the intersection of strategy, finance, commercial negotiations and execution. Your focus will be to turn complex partnership opportunities into clear business cases, workable commercial terms and agreements that support the needs of Nebius, our partners and our customers.

Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Unser Ziel ist es, die größte deutsche Hausverwaltung durch Buy & Build aufzubauen. Du baust dafür den M&A Funnel auf, der dieses Wachstum trägt. Nach 6 Monaten kennen wir alle relevanten Hausverwaltungen und die ersten sind gekauft. Nach 12 Monaten wurden alle relevanten Verwaltungen mehrfach von uns kontaktiert, und wir stehen mit allen in engem Austausch, die sich einen Verkauf vorstellen können.

Du baust einen Datensatz mit allen relevanten Hausverwaltungen auf

description:
📍 Wir suchen dich!
Für unseren Standort in Kreuzberg suchen wir ab sofort eine Pflegefachkraft stationär (m/w/d) in Vollzeit und Teilzeit.

🙋 Wer wir sind
Wir betreiben ein Pflegeheim mit derzeit 30 Bewohnerinnen und Bewohnern. Unser Haus wird von einem kleinen, eingespielten Team getragen. Viele Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten schon lange zusammen. Der Umgang ist direkt und unkompliziert. Die Wege sind kurz, Entscheidungen werden zügig getroffen.
Wir versorgen überwiegend chronisch kranke Menschen. Neben der pflegerischen und medizinischen Betreuung sind wir auch hauswirtschaftlich für unsere Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner da. Unsere Arbeit folgt dem Grundgedanken, jedem Menschen ein würdevolles Leben zu ermöglichen, seine Lebensqualität zu sichern und seine Selbstständigkeit zu fördern.

🎁 Was wir bieten
Außertarifliche Entlohnung, plus Bonus, Sonn-, Feiertags- und Nachtzuschlag

Einbindung in die betriebliche Altersversorgung

Förderung von Aus- und Weiterbildung

Unfallschutz im betrieblichen und außerberuflichen Bereich

Engagement für offene Kommunikation, Toleranz und Respekt auf allen Ebenen

Zeit für gute Pflegequalität

Gute Schichtbesetzungen

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.
We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. title: AI Platform Engineer
summary: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world…
description:
About us
People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.
Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.
Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work
Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role
We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product…

summary: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At…
description:
About Flock
Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.
We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.
We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

About the role
Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.
It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

What you’ll be doing
Own the month-end close from start to finish…

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
skills: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
summary: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding…
description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. 

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. 

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. 

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based…

About Morpho
Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

Why Morpho Exists
Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).
Jouw werkzaamheden
In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten.

Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate.

Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren).

Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s.

Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten.

Daarnaast brengen de analyses verbanden tussen verschillende bodemeigenschappen verder in kaart.

Het monitoringnetwerk genereert puntdata over Vlaanderen. Om die data gebiedsdekkend te maken, combineer je puntdata met gebiedsdekkende predictoren via digital soil mapping en random forest. BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.
We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.
You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.
We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

Individual contributor. Reports to the Director of QA. No direct reports.

You test the web application, frontend and backend, and the mobile applications on iOS and Android. That is the surface of the job.

We are looking for extreme ownership, the person who picks up the task nobody else wants because it needs doing and they can see why it matters.

Test the product properly. Web end to end, frontend behaviour and backend responses, not just the UI layer. Mobile on iOS and Android against an agreed device and OS matrix, with a real understanding of platform conventions and where the two diverge.

About myTomorrows 
myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   
We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.

To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today.

Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem.
Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit.

description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science
Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET
About Claims
AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.
We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.
The team
Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.
Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

Demo Engineering shows customers how Stripe works instead of just telling them. description:
Who we are 

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Chief Business Officer organization plays a pivotal role in driving the company’s growth and expansion efforts worldwide. Our teammates work on commercializing Airbnb’s new and existing businesses, helping Airbnb expand beyond its core offering as a place to stay. This includes recruiting and developing Airbnb’s global supply of high-quality stays, Experiences, and services, and executing Airbnb’s global in market strategy. With this focus on business strategy, quality supply and international expansion, the team is leading the way for Airbnb’s continued growth and facilitation of millions more host and guest connections.

The Difference You Will Make

description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Figma’s Interaction Design team helps designers express how interactive experiences behave from a single interaction, to a multi-state flow, to a series of complex animated transitions. We’re interested in making complex interactive behavior easier to author, refine and understand. This team investigates and identifies new ways to visualize and manage state, animations, interactions, and prototypes through click-through and code-backed experiences.

As a PhD intern, you’ll combine HCI research with hands-on-engineering to help define the next generation of interactive experience design tooling. You’ll work closely with a mentor and teammates and get to learn, contribute, and grow in a supportive environment, while applying your research background to drive real-world impact.

This 12 or 16-week internship for Summer 2027 will be based out of our San Francisco or New York hub.

What you’ll do at Figma:

Be fully embedded onto a Figma team working on problems that intersect with your research area

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Airbnb's Online Data organization gives every engineer at Airbnb the power to build real-time data experiences — through simple, intuitive tools, without needing deep database expertise.

Within Online Data, the Storage Foundation team owns the online serving stores and databases that power Airbnb. We build and operate Airbnb's source-of-truth database: an open-source, distributed NewSQL system running on stateful Kubernetes. It stores critical data — users, listings, and more — and handles over half of all of Airbnb's online OLTP traffic. Our charter: keep this database reliable, secure, scalable, fast, correct, well-tested, and cost-efficient — at Airbnb's scale.

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb’s Data Infrastructure organization builds the platforms that power data across the company. Within it, the Data Movement & Transformation (DMT) pillar builds the platform that moves data between Airbnb’s storage engines and transforms it along the way.

Today, data moves through many bespoke, one-off pipelines that are built and maintained differently by each team. We’re replacing them with one unified, declarative platform. You define data once, and it is replicated everywhere it needs to go. This work underpins Airbnb’s Data as a Service initiative.

You’ll join the team that owns three connected layers of that platform:

Control plane: the layer that turns declarative data definitions into running pipelines, including provisioning, runtime selection, and lifecycle management.

Schema: how schemas are defined, tracked, and evolved safely across every system and engine.

Realtime Data Infrastructure (RTDI): Kafka and the streaming transport layer that real-time data flows through at scale.

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Airbnb’s public policy campaign team exists to further the interests of our community of hosts and guests with politicians, regulators, opinion leaders and others who shape the political and legal context for our business, helping them to understand the significant social and economic contributions of our platform. Across the region, we are engaged in hundreds of local conversations and negotiations with governments big and small. We engage governments at local, state, provincial and national levels directly and also use innovative advocacy and partnership strategies that actively involve our community and our stakeholders in making the case for fair, progressive home sharing rules.

The Difference You Will Make:

Airbnb’s Public Policy team aims to work closely with politicians, regulators, and the broader public to introduce them to Airbnb, highlight the significant social and economic contribution our business makes to local areas and its residents, and showcase best practices from around the world. We want policymakers to understand the regulatory challenges that affect our community…

The Homes Enterprise team sits at the heart of this mission. We ensure that Airbnb's supply engine runs efficiently and intelligently - from how we identify demand and supply imbalances, to acquiring, vetting, onboarding and growing our host base, to how we communicate at scale, plan markets globally, and operate our field sales teams across every region. The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention.  We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.

Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.

The Observability team builds the platform Airbnb engineers use to understand how their systems behave in production. Our metrics platform alone ingests tens of millions of samples per second across more than a billion active time series. AI agents are now consumers of this data alongside engineers: they query telemetry to write and validate code and to help debug production issues. We continue to invest in reliable and efficient real time system for both AI and human access.

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The DACH Enterprise team is at the forefront of driving revenue and growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. As trusted business partners, we work with the most ambitious market leaders and high-growth innovators — DeepL, Refurbed, N26 to Nestlé — helping them build the financial infrastructure that powers their next stage of growth. We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem-solving.

Stripe's financial infrastructure is the engine that unlocks new revenue streams, automates complex local compliance, and drives global expansion for the region's most prominent businesses. This is a pivotal moment for Stripe in DACH — the market opportunity is significant, and our team serves as a critical source of user feedback and market intelligence, with direct influence on the product roadmap and growth strategy. description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…
